question_patterns.population_aggregate: (?i)^(?:count |how many |return the total |return the share |break down |show the .*distribution)

selection_rule: For each type/WG take lexicographically first exact original question matching fixed regex; retain missing type/WG explicitly. Same ID may illustrate two types and is audited once.
layers: original-source document actually located and exact evidence fragment supports requested role
retained text corpus contains actual source/fragment; name/string presence alone is insufficient
C/D ranked candidates vs final bounded context: actual source identities/windows inspected
the actual supplied evidence is sufficient for the entire requested list/count/chain under the stated finite frozen population; unknown remains unknown
no_sufficiency_from: a correct or incorrect model score
all_source_cutoff_equivalence: UNKNOWN unless a content/identity inventory witness is actually established
missing_policy: Record unknown/absent-in-inspected-snapshot separately; never infer source unavailability from a retrieval timeout or nonretrieval.
